title: Possession of a Weapon for an Unlawful Purpose
grade_or_penalty: Firearm: 2nd degree. Explosives or destructive devices: 2nd degree. Other weapons: 3rd degree. Imitation firearm: 4th degree
key_points: Possessing a weapon with purpose to use it unlawfully against the person or property of another.
elements: The suspect possessed a firearm or other weapon (or imitation firearm)
The suspect knew he possessed it
The suspect had a purpose to use it unlawfully against the person or property of another
